overview_description.description: The Compagn Compagnons du Dev  was founded in June 2013 with the objective of offering the keys of the digital world to the widest possible audience. Beyond the appropriation of tools, they want to accompany citizens to become digital artisans , to open new access routes to education, employment, culture and social ties and to build a civil society More participatory.
